title: 3 Bites From Your Mattress 🩸 (Things Living In Your House #47)
pinned_comment: Would you still sleep in that bed tonight? Yes or no 🛏️

source_quotes.epa: Adult bed bugs, in general, are: about the size of an apple seed (5-7 mm or 3/16 - 1/4 inch long); ... balloon-like, reddish-brown, and more elongated (if fed recently)
source_quotes.cdc: Bed bugs bite people and animals at night while they sleep, feeding on their blood. / they inject fluids (anesthetic and anticoagulant) that prevents a person from feeling the bite when it happens / Bed bugs are not known to spread diseases to people. / They can live several months without a blood meal. / The bugs hide during the day in places on or around the bed ... The seams of mattresses
